Browse tutorials

Source: vignettes/tutorials.Rmd
tutorials.Rmd

Tutorials for each step of a Giotto analysis, from building the object to spatial patterns and integration with other tools. Each one runs on a small example dataset, but the methods apply to any platform. For end-to-end examples on a specific technology, see Browse datasets; to set Giotto up, see Installation.
